grammar.summary: 本课学习间接引语的时态回移。

points.title: 间接引语（引述动词过去时）
points.explanation: 直接引语 I'm busy → He said (that) he was busy. 时态回移规则：现在→过去、现在完成→过去完成、will→would。本课 secretary 传话场景完整展示。

examples.en: He asked me if I had enjoyed my holiday.
examples.cn: 他问我假期是否过得愉快。

points.title: Interrupted speech 的语用
points.explanation: Do you speak English? 重复打断对方，口语强调句型。
